note: Large Inyo NF campground just west of US-395 north of Mammoth Lakes, along Glass Creek at the foot of Obsidian Dome: big open dirt sites scattered across a pine flat, close to the Owens River headwaters. Six people and two vehicles a site (the double site 12 and 4). Bear country. --Claude
summary: Glass Creek (Inyo): free, first-come (no rec.gov listing), 66 dry sites to 45 ft, vault toilets, no water, 14 days, about May 1-Oct 31; FS page 'Site Open'. Pin ~320 m east of the sites -> 37.7517,-118.9897. Website forest home -> campground page.
